candidate_A01_closest_keys.Q052: Stack attached cards on each site;stack sites top Cradle on top,bottom Hinterland bottom,save World Box. Boards saved current Exile/Citizen sides. New people can join;non-Chancellors choose among saved boards in turn order unless group agrees reservations.
candidate_A01_closest_keys.Q083: Both markers start on their first/star spaces (Round1 and Visions Drawn0). Starting with the Chancellor each round, go clockwise with one turn per player. Each turn is Wake, Act, Rest in that order. After every player has taken a turn, the round ends: check the applicable end-of-round victory condition before advancing the round marker; round8 ends automatically.
candidate_A01_closest_keys.Q025: Plains top Cradle,purple pawn,two purple garrison,Longbows; Mountain top Provinces,Red/Blue pawns,one purple,Taming Charm; Rocky Coast top Hinterland,Yellow pawn,one purple,Elders. Other sites facedown. Facedown advisers Chancellor Forest Paths,Red Animal Playmates,Blue Naysayers,Yellow A Small Favor. Ivory Eye facedown at Mountain. Preserve packet deck order.
candidate_A01_closest_keys.Q084: Use the assigned facedown advisers instead of later-game adviser draws. Put three facedown cards in the Cradle discard, three in the Provinces discard and five in the Hinterland discard. Put the remaining41 denizen/Vision cards on the World Deck space in Packet B order. Give the Chancellor the Grand Scepter, put Ivory Eye facedown at Mountain, put the next four relic cards facedown in the four Reliquary spaces, and the remaining15 on the Relic Deck space. Preserve the packet instructions/order rather than replacing this with later setup’s bottom draws and random preparation.

candidate_A02_closest_keys.Q002: Supremacy/Conquest: most sites; People/Rebellion: People’s Favor; Protection/Sanctuary: most relics and banners combined; Devotion/Faith: Darkest Secret. Exile must have the Vision revealed, fulfill it at Wake (or the round-eight check), and at least three Visions must have been drawn from the world deck. Most means strictly more than every other player, not a tie.
candidate_A02_closest_keys.Q005: Supremacy: more relics+banners than Chancellor and every other Citizen; People: Darkest Secret; Protection: People’s Favor; Devotion: Grand Scepter. Citizens do not win by Usurper or Vision, only replace a Chancellor win via succession.
candidate_A02_closest_keys.Q020: Vision-only winner uses matching Oath; other/multiple-method win chooses any different Oath. Exile winner flips all Citizens even boxed to Exile then may offer other Exiles except newly flipped; accepted map garrisons replaced one each by winner warband (ignore normal offer). Rebuild remaining denizens: ten+two random Visions=12 top, fifteen+three Visions=18 middle, remaining denizens bottom. Chronicle aid 12 denizens+2 is erroneous.
candidate_A02_closest_keys.Q021: Four favor per suit bank (three with two–four players). People’s Favor normal with one favor, Darkest Secret one secret. Chancellor two favor,one secret,three purple board warbands; other players one favor,one secret,three board warbands (own color Exile,purple Citizen). All full Supply.
